# RageTV

> Ultra-fast, privacy-first live esports hub. Pick a game, watch official tournament streams instantly on Twitch & YouTube with zero clutter and zero video hosting.

## Overview
RageTV is a zero-latency esports viewing console that aggregates verified official tournament streams directly from authorized platforms (Twitch and YouTube embeds). RageTV does not host, re-stream, store, or monetize video content.

## Key Game Routes
- Counter-Strike 2: https://ragetv.vercel.app/cs2
- Valorant: https://ragetv.vercel.app/valorant
- League of Legends: https://ragetv.vercel.app/lol
- Dota 2: https://ragetv.vercel.app/dota2
- PUBG: Battlegrounds: https://ragetv.vercel.app/pubg

## Single-Key Keyboard Controls
- T: Toggle Theater Mode (centers player, minimizes peripheral clutter)
- K: Toggle Play / Pause state
- M: Toggle Audio Mute
- B: Toggle Left Sidebar drawer

## Architecture & Privacy
- Completely cookieless: Zero cookies, zero third-party tracking analytics.
- Official Embeds Only: Uses Twitch Interactive Player and YouTube No-Cookie Player.
- Client-Side State: User theme (dark/light), locale (tr/en/de), and drawer states are stored strictly in browser localStorage.
